'''Kallos Sook''' was the first [[Regent/Legends|regent]] of [[Kaadara]], a small [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Sook was remembered for hiring a large contingent of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to act as the city's [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]].

==Biography==
Around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], a group of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] colonized [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> About a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="AED" /> around [[2900 BBY]],<ref name="Founding">{{GalaxiesAED}} stated that Kaadara was founded about one [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the first [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers arrived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the settlers arrived around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]]. This article's date is therefore derived from simple math based on this reference explanation.</ref> the small [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaadara]] was founded along a scenic coastline in the northern reaches<ref name="AED" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Early in its history, Kaadara was unique among Naboo cities because the local populace welcomed, and even encouraged, interactions with the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. Kaadara's first [[Regent/Legends|regent]], Kallos Sook, actually hired a large contingent of Gungans to serve as the city's [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]]. However, in the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] following Sook's regency, the increased presence of outsiders led the suspicious Gungans to abandon their role as protectors of Kaadara. The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] then went on to install a small [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in their stead.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kallos Sook was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sook was briefly mentioned in the description overview for [[W:c:swg:Kaadara|Kaadara]], a [[W:c:swg:City|city]] on the [[W:c:swg:Planet|planet]] [[W:c:swg:Naboo|Naboo]].<ref name="AED" />
